items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Followed by Robert Horne, he was a cramettes player. He played alto sax with me.

ctx.x: Just always a small band, was it about six or seven or how many? He used seven pieces in his band. Yeah.

About what day? He used cramettes, cram bones, and then he used the alto sax. Who played alto? Followed by Robert Horne, he was a cramettes player. He played alto sax with me. Sometime when I used to be working, Robert Horne used to dub them. He played the clarinet and his sax. Did you ever touch the clarinet, Steve? You mean the sax? You mean the sax? No, I never didn't bother with it. No. I just loved that clarinet. I didn't like no sax. I loved that clarinet.
Did you ever play an E-flat clarinet or have an A clarinet? No, no, I never played either one of those.
